idea-plugin.name: Paste Image as File
idea-plugin.description:
Paste a screenshot or copied image straight into a folder of your project.

Select a folder (or a file in it) in the Project / Explorer tree and press Ctrl+V (or Cmd+V on macOS): the clipboard image is saved there as screenshot-2026-10-04-153012.png. No more saving the image somewhere, finding it, and dragging it into the project.

Only acts when the clipboard holds an image; pasting files or text works as before.

This build also supports JetBrains Remote Development by delegating the upload to the IDE's native file paste action.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Unreleased: support Remote Development and Cmd+V on macOS.
1.0.1: requires IDE 2025.3 or newer.
